# Municipal Ordinance No. 04, Series of 2020

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 04**

*Isang Kautusang Bayan na Nagtatakda ng mga Regulasyon, Alituntunin, Panuntunan sa Pagtatayo ng Komersyal na Manukan (Poultry), Broiler-Layer sa Bayan ng Pitogo, Quezon*

An ordinance prescribing regulations and guidelines for establishing commercial poultry and broiler-layer operations in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]].

## Summary

Enacted on February 17, 2020, this ordinance provides the regulatory framework for commercial poultry farming, including broiler and layer operations, in [[Pitogo]]. Similar in structure to its companion ordinance [[MO-03-S2020]] (commercial piggery), it sets requirements for permits, facility standards, environmental compliance, and operational guidelines. The ordinance was filed under Serye ng Taong 2019 but enacted and numbered as part of the 2020 series.

## Key Provisions

- **Regulatory Framework.** Prescribes regulations, guidelines, and standards for the establishment and operation of commercial poultry farms (manukan), including broiler and layer operations, within [[Pitogo]].
- **Permit Requirements.** Commercial poultry operators must secure the necessary permits and clearances before commencing operations.
- **Site Requirements.** Establishes minimum distance requirements and zoning considerations for poultry farm locations relative to residential areas and water sources.
- **Environmental Compliance.** Requires proper waste management systems, including handling of poultry manure and wastewater, to prevent environmental contamination.
- **Biosecurity Standards.** Mandates compliance with health and biosecurity standards for poultry housing, feeding, and disease prevention.
- **Penalties.** Violators shall be subject to fines and penalties as prescribed under the ordinance.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
